cover.coreProposition: Workspace trust becomes an enforceable authority boundary only when its result shapes capability admission: negative or unresolved trust should reduce the effective executable surface before materialization, while revoking capability instances that already exist remains a separate lifecycle responsibility.
cover.visualMetaphor: A workspace package reaches a narrow gate that allows only independently authorized tools through
cover.semanticObject: A guarded capability aperture with a filtered bundle and a smaller executable set
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover emphasizing reduction of capability surface before execution
